newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber moves limit up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber moves limit up on short covering.

text.p: CME lumber futures posted limit gains of $10 per thousand board feet in January and limitless November was up $18.00 early, largely on short covering in the wake of limit gains Thursday, analysts and traders said.
A two-day suspension of Canadian lumber exports to the United States and ideas future shipments will be impeded because of quota restrictions, prompted the early buying, traders said.
On Thursday, Canada said it suspended lumber export permits Wednesday and Thursday, but would resume issuing permits Friday.
At 0917 CST, lumber was up $18.00 to $8.20 per tbf. Limitless November was up $18.00 at $440.00 and January was up $10.00 at $394.40.
